- [AZC E-commerce](https://www.rashidc.in/projects/azc-ecommerce): production online store for GCC customers with Stripe and PayPal, Next.js SEO and an OpenAI-powered feature.
- [Polosys Books](https://www.rashidc.in/projects/polosys-books): back-end contract work on a multi-tenant SaaS ERP for the GCC (Django REST Framework, AWS Lambda and RDS).
- NIBX (thenibx.com): website for a US bulk electronics supplier in Miami, Florida.
- KeralaBooks: multi-tenant bakery sales and purchase ledger (in progress).
